blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Police arrested 13 people and seized P12 million worth of equipment during an operation against an alleged Philippines Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hub here late Wednesday evening, the Iligan City Police Office (ICPO) said Thursday. Maj. Sandrex Panolong, ICPO public information officer, said investigators spent five months developing the case before carrying out the operation against Armsoft Information Technology Solutions at around 10:40 p.m. at the second floor of Ali Property Building in Purok 2B, Barangay Hinaplanon. Panolong said the establishment secured a permit from the Iligan City government in May 2026 as a technology information service provider. […]...
